raw_text:
VERDICT goal: The node goal is that the served why read answers within its 30 s deadline on the reckon and nova mounts by removing the discovery cost a fresh profile finds; reckon/git_dates.py:356 and reckon/git_dates.py:521 now ask _run_git to report a bound expiring and record the fallback against HEAD, and the recorded runs show reckon 38.4 s to 15.9 s and nova 10.4 s to 9.5 s at a warm RECKON_HOME.
VERDICT done_when: The measure is elapsed seconds of a scoped reckon.mcp._read_plan(view="why") call per mount plus a base-failing test; logs/measure_why.py enters discovery_file_scope() and resource_scan_scope(), and logs/head-reckon-2.log prints ANSWERED in 15.9 s with counts equal to logs/base-reckon-warm.log (waits_on 14, waited_on_by 0).
VERDICT write_paths: The prompt declares reckon/git_dates.py, tests/test_the_served_why_read_answers_within_its_deadline.py and the evidence fragment, and git diff --stat c8492882..3831c35a shows exactly those three files and nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: Read; it records status complete, the three commits, both armed suite arms and the importer arms with log paths and EXIT lines, the one flaky importer id under retry_failures with an attribution, and the cold-home stage under outside_scope.
VERDICT diff: Read commit by commit: a5dafa20 adds the timeout sentinel and the head-keyed record at reckon/git_dates.py:30-40 and :288-303, edebdc6b reformats the two staged paths, and 3831c35a adds only the evidence fragment.
CALL_SITES: reckon/serve.py:1302, reckon/serve.py:1587, reckon/doccheck.py:279
SCORE goal_fidelity: 17
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/git_dates.py:359 now reuses a recorded timeout at one HEAD, cutting the warm-home reckon read to 15.9 s, though the fresh-home first read stays at 103.6 s.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: logs/measure_why.py runs the call inside both request scopes and logs/head-reckon-2.log carries the elapsed figure the fragment quotes, while the fragment's head revision (line 27) does not match the logs' a5dafa2056.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the three changed files are the prompt's declared paths shown by git diff --stat c8492882..3831c35a, and the out-of-scope cold-home stage is recorded under outside_scope rather than changed.
SCORE durability: 17
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_the_served_why_read_answers_within_its_deadline.py:26 counts git log spawns the code performs and logs/base-arm.log fails there with assert 4 == 2, though the sentinel's separation from a spawn error is untested.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: the helper at reckon/git_dates.py:288 sits among its sibling lookup helpers and follows the module's persisted-map idiom, with no plan label or ticket reference in any added name or docstring.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the addition extends the module's own persisted-map owner (same _GitCreationEntry, same _store_git_creation_cache, same head-keyed reuse) rather than adding a second store, and no other mechanism in the repository records a bounded git query outcome.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/a-project-reads-as-one-picture/the-served-why-read-answers-within-its-deadline.html:24 non-blocking: the landing figure is the warm-home read (15.9 s), while the node's goal names the cost a fresh profile finds and the fragment's own table records 103.6 s for the first read of a fresh RECKON_HOME on reckon, still over the 30 s deadline; the figure is disclosed at line 35, but the headline reads as the mount meeting its deadline in every case.

FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/a-project-reads-as-one-picture/the-served-why-read-answers-within-its-deadline.html:27 non-blocking: the fragment says the head arm ran head edebdc6b, but logs/head-reckon-2.log and logs/head-nova-2.log name revision a5dafa2056; edebdc6b is formatting-only so the figures stand, yet the record's stated revision does not match its sources.
FINDING reckon/git_dates.py:361 non-blocking: a timeout — which the new _GitQueryTimedOut docstring at line 27 calls an answer about the machine — is persisted as though it were the repository's answer, so one transient expiry on a quiet repository leaves the date maps empty until HEAD moves and the warning is logged once; an expiry on the recorded entry would bound it.
